rule: img_<global>.png in class c  <->  os.listdir(test/c)[global - class_start(c)]; classes sorted; class_start = cumulative counts in sorted-class order
why_committed: os.listdir order is filesystem-dependent. Rebuilding this mapping on a different machine (e.g. Colab/ext4 vs macOS/APFS) yields a DIFFERENT and WRONG mapping, silently corrupting every cross-distribution paired join. This file is the authoritative artifact; downstream code must read it and must never regenerate it.
